ride_snapshot.why: Private, offline summary after a ride; cloud fallback keeps older devices working.

event_interpretation.why: Sensor windows are sensitive and often captured in dead zones.

incident_interview.why: Incident evidence and statements must not leave the device unless the user exports them.

incident_photo.why: iOS 26 on-device Foundation Models is text-only; cloud handles the image.

weekly_feedback.why: Cross-ride context and larger reasoning benefit from cloud Gemini.

risk_analyst.why: Requires cross-rider aggregates that only the cloud can see.

credential_narrative.why: The credential is issued from aggregate data and signed server-side.

insurer_report.why: Final document generation benefits from the larger cloud model.
